title: FormSubmitRequest
description: Request body for POST /api/panels/:id/submit (HEL-1087). `values` and the optional `submitKey` (HEL-1175) are the ONLY recognized keys -- a `form` panel's submit target is its own persisted `dataSourceId`, never a value the request can name, so any other top-level key is rejected rather than silently ignored.

values.description: `{"<sourceField>": <typed JSON value>}` -- the submitted values, keyed by the dataset's declared field name.

submitKey.description: Optional idempotency key (HEL-1175), a client-minted UUID. A same-key re-send by the same submitter through the same panel appends nothing and answers 200 with the original row; any other submitter or panel gets 409. Absent: today's behaviour. Not read on the multipart submit.
